help: Metrowerks-compiled PS2 code: function boundaries for the recompiler
PCSX2 GS render-target and texture corruption on menu backgrounds
Sidhe Mab engine / RenderWare 3.7 stream formats
approach: The PS2 executable (SLUS-21627) statically recompiled to C++ with PS2Recomp on the Urban Reign PC port's runtime: the game's IRX modules interpreted, VU1 compiled ahead of time, PCSX2's GS as a library (Vulkan on Linux). Linux first, brought up bottom up one hardware layer at a time, each checked against PCSX2; a native renderer later.
notes: Boots on Linux through the opening video, title screen and menus into gameplay: the first stunt runs with its HUD and pause menu. Seven runtime patches so far (boot args, TTY, IOP module arena, R5900 PMFHL/LO1-HI1, EE-to-IOP SIF commands, runtime arena, IOP disc search for FMOD sound banks). Open: corrupted textures/render targets on some menus, audio output, speed. Repo shaped like Vnnc1/gow-native-pc (game profile, pinned runtime, numbered patches). No game data included: bring your own PS2 copy.
